input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. §14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right (reinforced by §15.1's no-sale/no-advertising/no-model-training limits). §14.2 vests ownership of Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment, personnel assignments and further assurance. §14.3 leaves Vendor only its pre-existing Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology into the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business. §14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument and preserves our unrestricted feedback rights. Only minor sub-preferred details: the "subject to payment of the applicable Fees" condition on Deliverable ownership and no express sublicence word in §13.2 (contractor support is allowed) — noted, not flagged.
